Exercise A

Listening: School Trip

You will hear each recording twice, just like in the real MSA exam. Listen carefully, then answer the questions below — you won't be able to play a recording more than twice.

💡 Exam tip: In the real exam you hear each recording exactly twice — use the first play to get the general gist, then the second to fill in exact details, rather than trying to catch everything at once.
Part 1 — Announcement
Part 1 — Comprehension Questions

1 What time does the bus leave?

2 What must every student bring with them?

3 What time does the museum close?

4 What time will students be back at school?

5 Why should students bring a raincoat?

Part 2 — Dialogue: Packing for the Trip
Part 2 — Comprehension Questions

6 What does Emma suggest Tom bring instead of a thick coat?

7 How much extra money does Emma suggest for the gift shop?

8 What is not allowed near the dinosaurs?

Exercise B

Reading: Museum Zones & Notices

Read the texts below, then answer the questions — just like Reading Parts 1 and 2 in the real MSA exam.

Part 1 — Match the Student to the Museum Zone

Space Zone: Explore a full-size model of the International Space Station and find out what astronauts eat for breakfast in orbit.

Robotics Zone: Watch robot arms build tiny towers and try programming a small robot to move around a maze.

Dinosaur Zone: Walk beneath a life-size Tyrannosaurus rex skeleton and touch real dinosaur fossils.

Weather Zone: Stand inside a wind tunnel and learn how storms and hurricanes form.

1 Liam wants to learn how to control machines. He should visit the .

2 Priya has always loved prehistoric creatures. She should visit the .

3 Tom dreams of being an astronaut one day. He should visit the .

4 Emma is curious about storms and hurricanes. She should visit the .

Part 2 — Museum Notices: True or False?

📷 No flash photography in the Dinosaur Zone — flashes can damage the fossil surfaces.

🚧 Please stay behind the yellow line in the Robotics Zone at all times.

☕ The café closes at 3:30pm, one hour before the museum closes.

🔑 Lockers cost £1 — please bring the correct change.

5 You are allowed to use flash photography in the Dinosaur Zone.

6 Visitors must stay behind the yellow line in the Robotics Zone.

7 The café closes at the same time as the museum.

8 Lockers are free to use.

Exercise C

Writing: Blog Post

Choose ONE of the two prompts below and write 80–100 words, just like Writing Part 3 in the real MSA exam. This section is graded by your teacher, not automatically.

Choose ONE prompt

Prompt 1: Describe the exhibit or zone you enjoyed most on the museum trip, and explain why.

Prompt 2: Imagine you are writing to a friend who missed the trip. Describe what happened during the day and what they missed.
